answer_1.quote: For (1), EMG-RAG can generate answers to users' questions when they interact with the smartphone AI assistants.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to user questions for question answering, autofill forms, and user services

answer_2.quote: For question answering, we assess the quality of generated answers with the ground truth, and reporting ROUGE (R-1/2/L) and BLEU scores.

answer_3.quote: For LLM evaluation, we employ a method where GPT-4 self-verifies whether it can generate answers (or entities) that are consistent with those obtained during the data collection, based on the collected questions and required memories.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly selected 10% of the user data and asked five participants to annotate the answers (for QA) and entities (for AF and US) based on the collected questions and memories.
answer_4.guideline: By comparing the human-annotated answers and entities with those generated by GPT-4
